headline: Kai, the American consumer flinched — retail sales fell, sentiment hit 51, and the market still banked a third straight winning week.
subline: Oil holds above $81 under the Hormuz blockade, the 10-year sits at 4.70%, and the Warsh Fed's first Jackson Hole is on deck.
asof: Saturday · markets closed · strip shows Friday's session · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Retail sales fall 0.6%, weakest in a year
items.sentence: July sales fell 0.6% to $763.6 billion against forecasts for a 0.1% gain, the weakest reading in over a year, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Consumer sentiment sinks to 51; inflation expectations rise
items.sentence: The University of Michigan's preliminary index dropped to 51.0 from 55.2 as year-ahead inflation expectations rose to 4.3%, per Yahoo Finance — and American Banker reports markets now lean toward a Fed hold.

items.title: Third straight weekly gain; Nvidia looms August 26
items.sentence: The S&P 500 closed at 7,785.76, down 0.17% from Thursday's record, still capping a third straight winning week ahead of Walmart and Target earnings and Nvidia's August 26 report, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Ten-year tests 19-month highs, settles at 4.70%
items.sentence: The 10-year touched 19-month highs near 4.75% during the week before settling Friday at 4.70%, up 0.05 points on the day, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Russell 2000 sets records as Reddit joins S&P
items.sentence: TheStreet's Friday board shows WTI at $81.71, gold at $4,405.30, and bitcoin at $62,681, with the Russell 2000 at fresh records and Reddit joining the S&P 500 before Monday's open.

items.title: U.S. says Iran blockade can run indefinitely
items.sentence: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the Navy can rotate ships to hold the blockade 'indefinitely' as ceasefire talks stall and Iran's crude revenues run at least $6 billion short since April, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Black Sea strikes send food prices to multi-year highs
items.sentence: Russian and Ukrainian attacks on civilian shipping are squeezing grain exports, with food prices at their highest since early 2023, per Democracy Now.

items.title: Indiana declares statewide emergency amid catastrophic flooding
items.sentence: Gov. Mike Braun declared a statewide disaster emergency as Midwest floodwaters rise, with record rainfall pushing rivers to historic highs, per ABC News and OANN.

items.title: China calls Taiwan drills a 'wasteful charade'
items.sentence: Beijing's defense ministry dismissed Taiwan's military drills as a 'wasteful charade' that 'stoked war panic,' per Reuters coverage in FDD's overnight brief.

items.title: Apple trains China-specific AI model with Alibaba
items.sentence: Apple trained its own model for China with Alibaba's assistance to expand Apple Intelligence there, per a Reuters report carried by Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash at half price
items.sentence: The new model targets coding and agent workloads and carries a 50% introductory price cut through year-end, per VentureBeat.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut prices; DeepSeek hikes 1,100%
items.sentence: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna pricing and added a Cerebras-backed Ultrafast mode, Anthropic trimmed Claude Opus 5 rates, and DeepSeek raised premium API prices as much as 1,100% — the price war now runs in both directions, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Pony.ai and Uber plan 2,000 European robotaxis
items.sentence: The two companies plan more than 2,000 robotaxis across five European cities in an expanded autonomous-driving partnership, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Big Tech's AI buildout nears $1.5 trillion committed
items.sentence: Tech Startups tallies Big Tech's AI infrastructure commitments near $1.5 trillion, with SMIC raising chip prices on 93.7% factory utilization.
